goal: Let the Claude Review Host settle a reservation when the observed reviewer hands its report back through the SubagentHandback tool and leaves no assistant text block in its transcript.

acceptance.assertion: readAgentTranscriptResult returns the report carried in input.message of a SubagentHandback tool_use record written by the observed agent, and whichever of that report or an assistant text message the agent wrote last is its result. A record from another agentId, a tool_use with any other name, and a non-string or blank message never answer for the reviewer. A reservation whose transcript holds only a handed-back report settles through consumeReview with the observed agent as actor. Existing per-record agentId matching, transcript path and identity checks, and all prior text-message behavior are unchanged; no new authority path, schema or Kernel change. The generated Claude bundle matches the runtime source.
